messages:
jen: Heads-up — prepping private-installer v1.9.0 packaging for the May17 change window. Packaging + cosign signing starts 2026-05-17 14:00 UTC. Will pin images and produce sealed manifest.

deploy-bot: Packaging job queued: job-id=pack-20260517-331, depends on: build-image-2019, cosign-key-check

jen: Key things: (1) image pins will use sha256 hashes, (2) submanifest will be sealed and escrowed to S3, (3) airgap transport window is 16:00–18:00 UTC. Expect ~45m transfer for first-site.

tom: Quick Q — are we rotating the cosign key before sealing? that would affect existing escrow verification flow.

jen: Not rotating for this delivery. We plan a separate key rotation in June. For this cut we MUST use the current signer to avoid client validation failures.

sahil: Transport note: remote installer team needs a final nonce file uploaded 30m before transport. I'll send the presigned URL once packaging completes.

ops-lead: Rollback criteria we agreed in weekly: failed image checksum on target >2 hosts, signer verification errors on >1 customer, or installer crashes during first 10m of execution for canary pool.

jen: Agreed. Emergency rollback plan (short):
- stop transport immediately (cancel rsync/transfer)
- notify customers + SRE channel
- unpin manifests in on-prem mirror (revert to last-known-good manifest)
- issue hotfix build if root cause in packaging

pkg-automation: Packaging job completed: job-id=pack-20260517-331, artifacts: installer-v1.9.0.tar.gz, sealed-manifest-20260517.json, image-pins:
```
redis-server: sha256:8f3a...a1b2
api-backend: sha256:3c2d...7f9e
frontend-runtime: sha256:5b1c...c4d0
```

jen: Uploading sealed manifest to escrow now. presigned URL will be posted to this thread once available.

deploy-bot: Escrow upload verified: escrow-id=escrow-20260517-12, checksum match ok.

tom: During canary do we deploy to vpc-onprem canary first or run installer dry-run? Recommend dry-run + checksum-only first.

ops-lead: Flow: 1) dry-run on two canary hosts (checksum & signer only), 2) small canary apply (10% pool), monitor 30m, 3) full transport. If dry-run fails -> abort, revert manifests.

jen: Dry-run command for ops:
```
./installer --manifest sealed-manifest-20260517.json --mode dry-run --verify-only
```

sahil: I'll kick off dry-run at 15:15 UTC once escrow url is in place.

pkg-automation: Escrow URL: https://s3.redwood-internal/escrow/escrow-20260517-12?signed=true (valid 2h)

maya: I'll be on-call for the window and will post status updates to #eng-oncall. If rollback triggered, I will coordinate the manifest revert and customer notifications.

ops-lead: Communication templates: please use this snippet for customer notif => "We are pausing the installer rollout for your cluster due to verification failure; we will revert to prior manifest and notify once validated. Estimated ETA: 45m." Use #customer-notifs for copy.

jen: Final checklist before 14:00 UTC: cosign key present, escrow upload path set, canary hosts reachable, ops + SRE oncall confirmed. Tag me if any blocker.

maya: All checks green from my side. standing by :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-05-17 13:45 UTC -> packaging starts.

jen: Great — proceeding. Will update thread with final manifest and signed image pins once done.
